svg.title: Known-and-novel compound / בדרך חדוש · שכבר נודע
svg.desc: Chapter 3, Hebrew p33, English p34. A plain circle and a four-point starburst sit at the same height inside the established violet compound bracket. One assertion is presented as already known, the other as a novel point. The starburst is a mnemonic for novelty, not greater truth, certainty, holiness, a question, or a resolution. No arrow or staircase specifies which is said first. Left/right positions are illustrative. The two source orders remain separate child icons. Ramchal describes this branch without assigning it a separate formal Hebrew name.
